zara-billing: Invoice INV-9073 (Noveltree) card declined: `card_declined` / `lost_card`. Customer says they replaced card this morning and updated portal. Can payments team retry? cc @sam-payments

sam-payments: If token shows `lost_card`, issuer will block charges even with new PM. Best to send hosted payment link to reprovision payment method and force auth. Want me to send link?

olivia-support: Customer on a monthly plan, wants to avoid service disruption. They said bank flagged suspicious activity and issued a replacement card.

sam-payments: I'll send the link and monitor. Also note: auto-retry schedule will skip if status is "account_on_hold"; we'll need manual collect after customer completes 3DS. billing-bot, show retry schedule.

billing-bot: Auto-retry queued: attempts at 2221004321,2221090721. Current attempt_count=1. Status=blocked_by_issuer.

zara-billing: Please proceed with hosted link. If customer confirms success, I'll approve manual collect after 12h. @jake-cfo can we waive a single failed-attempt fee? 

jake-cfo: Waiver approved for one failed processing fee. Document in invoice comments.

sam-payments: Link sent at 2221004600. Monitoring logs now. I'll update thread when we see a successful payment_intent.
